column2: [intro]
I pretend to cry
But that, I'm used to it
I hide my true feelings
Behind this insolent mask
I find it a bit easy
To play the fragile one
To cry all the tears of one's body
But no one believes me
I laugh in front of the cameras
But deep down, I'm not there
I'm lost, alone in my head
No one to listen to me, to stop me
It's too easy to judge me
To tell me "you're not confident enough"
But no one knows the truth
That hides in my thoughts
[ solo ]
Come on, all together now
Let me show you who I really am
I'm just a fool playing his role
But deep down, I just need a little love.
[outro]
